description.narrative: (Tanzania): FY 2021 funds will support USAID/Tanzania's learning, helping the mission conduct sector and activity-specific assessments to inform strategic decision making, activity design, and necessary adaptations. Funds will support the mission's efforts to conduct required data quality assessments and data verification activities, in addition to assisting in the mission's transition to a new indicator reporting database. D4D will work with mission staff, USAID implementing partners (IP), and other stakeholders, such as Tanzania's National Bureau for Statistics, President's Office-Regional Administration and Local Governance, and the Office of the Chief Government Statistician-Zanzibar. Support will include capacity building to improve monitoring and reporting capabilities for development activities implemented by donors, the Government of Tanzania, and other implementers. Additionally, D4D will use geographic information systems technologies to further improve USAID's ability to use data to make strategic foreign assistance decisions. ...&amp;amp;amp;lt;!--td {border: 1px solid #ccc;}br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}--&amp;amp;amp;gt;
